attempts.answer:
<thought>This core covers physical offense (Garchomp, Dragonite), special offense (Gholdengo, Rotom-Wash), and defense (Garganacl, Annihilape). Garchomp and Dragonite run fast physical sets with Mega Stones for extra power, Rotom-Wash provides pivot and burn support, Gholdengo is a special wall/attacker immune to status moves, Garganacl is the salt-cure wall, and Annihilape punishes hits with Rage Fist. Speed tiers are set so Garchomp and Dragonite outpace the meta while the walls invest in bulk.</thought>
